# Fulcria Labs

> Swing Analyzer is a free beta web app from Fulcria Labs. Film your golf swing with your phone and it shows the one thing to fix, in plain English, with a drill.

## Swing Analyzer
- Checks three things: standing up through the ball, head movement, and rhythm.
- Works best filmed from behind you, in line with the target. Rhythm needs a slow-motion or 60 frames a second video.
- It is a beta and can be wrong. It does not see the club path or the ball.
